subject: general
question: In MS PowerPoint 2019, when you press the Enter key while typing in a text box, what happens?

options.text: The text is entered into a new slide.
The cursor moves to the next line within the same text box.
The text box is automatically resized.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The cursor moves to the next line within the same text box**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In MS PowerPoint 2019, pressing the Enter key within a text box moves the cursor to the next line, enabling multi-line text entry within the same box.
 
• It does not create a new slide or delete text; the text box continues to accommodate additional lines as needed.
 
• This functionality allows users to structure text into paragraphs, bullet points, or lists within the same text box.
 
• Text boxes are pre-configured to automatically adjust their size based on the amount of content, but pressing Enter does not trigger resizing; resizing occurs only when text exceeds the box dimensions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Text Boxes in PowerPoint:**

 
 
• Text boxes are containers used to input text in PowerPoint slides.
 
• They can be resized, repositioned, or formatted to match the desired slide layout.
 
• Text alignment, font size, and color can be customized within each text box.
 
 
 
• **Enter Key Behavior:**
 
 
• Pressing the Enter key creates a line break and moves the cursor to the next line within the text box.
 
• Shift+Enter can be used to insert a soft line break without creating a new paragraph.
 
 
 
• **Auto-Resizing Feature:**
 
 
• Text boxes in PowerPoint can automatically adjust their size if the content exceeds the box dimensions.
 
• This feature ensures that all content is visible without manual resizing.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts:**
 
 
• Ctrl+A selects all text within a text box.
 
• Ctrl+X cuts selected text, while Ctrl+C copies it.
 
• Ctrl+V pastes copied or cut text into the text box.
